0022600095.text: Indiana hosts Dallas in the Pacers' second game of the 2026-27 season. The Pacers are 1-0, including 1-0 on the road, and sit 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East, while the Mavericks are 0-1, 5th in the Southwest and one game back, and 11th in the West. Johnny Furphy is out for Indiana after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith and T.J. McConnell are day-to-day with hamstring issues and are game-time decisions. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), and Jett Howard (calf, game-time decision) and Santi Aldama (knee) are day-to-day; the teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers lost 0-2 to Dallas in 2025-26, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
